origin: Built-in image_gen; original generated game artwork
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: full-bleed 16:9 background environment plate for a premium original family motion game, no interface.
Primary request: A warmly lit handcrafted paper-and-clay garden clearing. This is far scenery and a blank play surface for a tennis game and a light exercise adventure; separate foreground gameplay is drawn over it.
Composition: fixed camera looking slightly downward across a very broad flat clearing toward a garden. Horizon at 32% of height. Upper third soft blue sky, rounded distant green hills, layered paper shrubs and Mediterranean cypress and broadleaf trees framing only far left and far right. Lower 65% a continuous warm ochre and terracotta fine clay/sand surface, gently textured and evenly lit, mostly empty, no central object, no path or triangle, no court lines. Leave a broad empty center all the way to the bottom. Soft shadows from distant foliage only along far side boundaries, clear center.
Style: sophisticated tactile miniature papercraft and matte clay, physical layered paper fibers, rounded sculpted forms, sunny inviting lighting upper left, restrained deep pine/teal foliage, warm cream light, terracotta ground. It belongs alongside a clay/paper family tennis cover with a teal-clad woman and coral-clad man, and tactile snowy mountain game art. Finished commercial game art; not flat polygon placeholder art.
Constraints: no people, no animals, no equipment, no net, no tennis lines, no text, logo, watermark, border or UI. Original imaginary park, no identifiable real location or household data.
